speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: Hi! How are you doing today?

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: I'm fine! How about you?

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: I'm doing great! It's been a busy day.

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: Yes, I've had a very busy day today. My day was productive too.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: Some people around the world have struggled to get through the day.

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: Yes they do struggle to get through the day, because some of their lives aren't fulfilling.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: Some people feel that we have an obligation to help those in need when we can. How do you feel?

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: I think it all depends on the circumstances.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: I'm thinking about children in developing countries that need help from those in better circumstances.

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: Sounds like a good cause.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: Have you heard of an organization called Save the Children?

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: I have heard about that organization.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: I wonder if you would be willing to help them out with a small donation.

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: At this point in my life, I am unable to give a donation to Save the Children.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: Your donation would come from part of the proceeds that you're earning right now. It wouldn't need to be much. Any amount helps.

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: I am aware that the donation would come from part of the earnings right now. I just don't want to donate anything.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: Save the Children is a worthy organization. Even 10 cents could make a difference to a child in Africa or Syria.

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: Yes, I believe that Save the Children is a worthy organization. I would like to keep my earnings.

speaker: A3T9K2RY06UO14
text: What would it take for your to commit to donating to Save the Children?

speaker: ATIAMDY7P54P
text: It would take away from me buying blocks for a child in the USA who don't have money to buy anything.
